content.text:
Pretty normal at 28 months. Lots of toddlers push back on bitter greens. Try putting one small bite of a green next to something he already likes, with no pressure to eat it. Eat some yourself in front of him, and keep serving it. It can take a lot of tries before he picks it up. Blending spinach into a smoothie or pancakes is a fine side route while he warms up.

Also, I told you before that I couldn't sign kids up for things. That's changed. If you send me a class, I can try signing him up once you say yes.
